full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a gallery visitor seated on a broad wooden bench, facing a large patterned artwork on a warm cream wall. The visitor sits near the lower center with back to the camera, short curly hair rising above a dark navy shirt covered in tiny light motifs. The bent legs and relaxed shoulders suggest a long, quiet look at the work rather than movement through the room. The artwork fills most of the upper frame inside a narrow dark frame. Its surface is divided into many neighboring sections: pale turquoise waves and circular motifs spread across the lower left, while a broad orange-pink rectangle with dense fine lines holds the center. At the upper left are black and cream diamonds, small drawn figures, and patterned strips. Toward the right, black-and-white swirls, checkerboard marks, and red accents crowd together at different scales. The panel feels flat in the gallery but visually busy, with repeated lines, curls, dots, and grids moving from section to section. A narrow strip of bare wall surrounds the frame, giving the colorful surface a clear boundary. The bench crosses the foreground horizontally with a glossy honey-brown top and darker support beneath. Gallery light falls evenly from above, making the wall and artwork bright while a mild shadow forms behind the seated visitor and under the bench. The floor is pale and smooth, reflecting a little warmth without competing with the patterned panel. The overall composition balances one still dark figure and simple gallery geometry against an expansive patchwork of turquoise, orange, cream, black, and red.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形彩色照片呈现一位画廊参观者坐在宽阔木凳上，面对暖奶油色墙面上一幅大型纹样作品。参观者背向镜头，坐在下方中央附近，短卷发露出一件布满浅色小图案的深海军蓝衬衫。弯曲的双腿和放松的肩膀暗示长时间安静观看，而非匆匆穿过房间。作品装在窄深色画框中，占据上半部大部分区域。画面被分成许多相邻区块：浅青绿色波纹与圆形纹样在左下展开，中央是一块铺满密细线条的宽阔橙粉色矩形。左上有黑奶油色菱格、小型画出的人形和纹样长条。靠右，黑白旋纹、棋盘格和红色点缀以不同尺度挤在一起。作品在画廊里是平面，视觉上却很繁忙，重复的线、卷曲、点和网格从一块游向另一块。画框周围留有一圈窄窄的裸墙，给多彩表面明确边界。长凳在前景水平横贯，蜂蜜棕色顶面带微光，下方支撑较暗。画廊光从上方均匀落下，使墙面与作品明亮，在坐着的人身后和凳下形成轻微阴影。地面浅而平滑，反射一点暖意，却不与纹样画板争夺注意力。整体构图以一个静止深色人物和简单展厅几何，平衡青绿、橙、奶油、黑与红的宽阔拼布。
style_prompt_en: The color photograph holds a crisp, evenly lit interior around a dense graphic surface. Broad rectangular divisions give structure to fine waves, curls, dots, checks, and parallel lines, letting many patterns coexist without losing the overall grid. Turquoise and coral-orange fields carry the strongest color, balanced by cream, navy-black, and small red accents. The surrounding surfaces are quiet and warm, with straight horizontal and vertical lines that make the intricate area feel more intense. Gentle overhead light creates only modest shadows and a slight sheen on smooth materials. The composition pairs a compact dark foreground accent with a much larger bright pattern field, creating a measured encounter between stillness and visual abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影以清晰均匀照明的室内空间包围密集图形表面。宽阔矩形分区为细波纹、卷曲、点、棋盘格和平行线提供结构，使许多纹样共处而不失整体网格。青绿与珊瑚橙色域承载最强色彩，奶油色、海军蓝黑和少量红色点缀形成平衡。周围表面安静而温暖，笔直水平线和竖线使繁复区域显得更强烈。温和顶光只造成适度阴影与光滑材料上的轻微亮泽。构图让紧凑的前景深色重音面对更宽阔的明亮纹样色域，形成静止与视觉丰盛之间从容的相遇。
theme_en: A seated gallery visitor facing a large patchwork of vivid patterns
theme_zh: 一位坐着的画廊参观者面对大型鲜艳纹样拼画
name: Contemporary art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
